svg.title: Opt-in worker ownership and reverse routing
svg.desc: Reference one worker stays default. Dispatcher owns both TUN files. Inside socket hash selects a bounded worker input. Replies select the owner by disjoint external destination port; the owner validates remote tuples before refresh. Workers own private NAT; bounded shared completions return to dispatcher transmit.

g.text: Safe ownership demonstrator; measured multicore is slower
Reference workers=1 default · opt-in 4 workers oversubscribe approved 2-vCPU guest
Inside / outside TUN
Precreated, NO_PI
No network setup
Dispatcher owns both device FDs
Validate → internal socket hash
Reply dst port → sole shard owner
Bounded try_send input queues
Bounded completion queue → TX
WouldBlock / full queue: counted drop
Shutdown flag → join every worker
Worker 0: private Router / disjoint range P0 and capacity C0
Remote tuple filter before refresh · monotonic expiry · no hot NAT lock
Worker 1: private Router / disjoint range P1 and capacity C1
Remote tuple filter before refresh · monotonic expiry · no hot NAT lock
Worker 2: private Router / disjoint range P2 and capacity C2
Remote tuple filter before refresh · monotonic expiry · no hot NAT lock
Worker 3: private Router / disjoint range P3 and capacity C3
Remote tuple filter before refresh · monotonic expiry · no hot NAT lock
Queue occupancy, shutdown discards, actual TX and optional bounded tuple-free samples → private snapshots
No shared NAT allocation · no migration · no AF_XDP / zero-copy / scaling claim
